prompts.title: 街头女警
prompts.content:
这是一张使用 Leica M10-R 相机配合 35mm f/1.4 镜头拍摄的 8K 超写实全景人像照片。画面呈现出一种纪实摄影风格，具有真实的胶片感颗粒、细腻的皮肤纹理和清晰的织物细节，比例为 9:16。

场景与氛围：
场景设定在一个夜晚的都市马路边柏油地面上，镜头紧凑地聚焦于主角。背景中可以看到模糊的 SUV 汽车、建筑、树木和街道标线。整体氛围融合了都市夜晚的冷酷自信与真实的街道质感。光线采用了城市夜间混合光源（环境街灯、汽车大灯、远处的建筑灯光），营造出既粗砺又干净的视觉效果，带有柔和但清晰的阴影。

人物特征：
主角是杨幂。她留着一头时髦的乌黑长发，拥有极具辨识度的面部特征，包括那双深邃且充满自信的眼睛。皮肤质感真实，保留了细微的毛孔，没有任何过度磨皮的痕迹，神情坚定且从容。

姿态与构图：
她采取低姿蹲坐的姿势，整个人物占据了画面约 80-85% 的高度，构图非常紧凑饱满。她双臂交叉抱于胸前，左腿向前弯曲，充分展示了大腿上的细节；右腿向后收拢。镜头从脚部的黑色高跟鞋到头顶的帽子完整覆盖全身，焦点锐利地集中在她的面部、发丝、制服纹理以及腿部的蕾丝细节上。

服装与配饰：

主体： 她穿着一套深藏青色警察风格短袖连身裙，剪裁合体，衣领上绣有精细的金色勋章补丁，袖口配有金色小徽章，金属与丝线的质感清晰可见。腰间束有一条黑色皮带。

腿部： 穿着极具细节感的黑色超薄丝袜，左大腿处有精密的黑色蕾丝袜带细节。脚上是一双光亮的黑色皮革细高跟鞋。

配饰： 头上斜戴着一顶精致的藏青色空乘风格小礼帽，帽子侧面的微型金色徽标清晰可见。

画面质感：
画面追求极致的高保真度和纹理对比，粗糙的柏油马路与精致的制服、丝袜、皮革高跟鞋形成鲜明对比。背景带有轻微的运动模糊，但整体依然保持了极简且不失力量感的纪实美学。

prompts.title: 关灯自拍
prompts.content:
画面主角是一位二十多岁的年轻女性，拥有苍白如瓷的肌肤，肤质真实，带有自然的毛孔和光泽，绝无过度磨皮的塑料感。她拥有柔和、类似玩偶般的面部轮廓、精致的小鼻子，以及自然的兔系丰满双唇，涂抹着淡淡的自然渐变唇色。双眼是迷人的杏仁形，微微眯起，流露出一种倦怠而迷人的性感神情，眉毛粗而直。

她留着自然的黑色短发，呈现出一种刚起床时的凌乱美，侧分的发型让几缕发丝随意地垂落在她的左眼上。

场景与氛围：
场景设定在一间深夜、昏暗的卧室内。背景几乎完全黑暗，带有柔软的阴影。画面左侧依稀可见深棕色的遮光窗帘。整个环境散发着一种深夜、慵懒、低保真（lo-fi）、私密且安静的氛围，带有一种舒适但凌乱的房间感觉。

光线与拍摄：
照片完全依靠低强度的手机屏幕光照明，光线呈现出一种偏冷的蓝紫色，柔和地照在她的脸上。环境光极暗，形成强烈的对比，使脸部被光线勾勒出轮廓，而背景则几乎是一片漆黑。避免使用任何暖色调、环形灯、闪光灯或专业影楼灯光。

拍摄视角设定为“我们即是她的手机”，是一个稍低角度的特写自拍。镜头极近，营造出一种亲密的距离感。画面中只能看到她的脸和上半身，裁剪紧凑。手机本身在画面中不可见。

人物姿态与神情：
她正趴在床上，用一个带有低调图案的灰色枕头支撑着身体。她的神情是无意间流露出的性感和疲惫：双眼皮沉重，眼神梦幻，嘴唇微张，呈放松状态。她的一只手靠近脸部，食指轻轻触碰着下唇。

着装细节：
她身穿一件紧身的白色短款T恤（cropped t-shirt），面料较薄，呈现出真实的拉伸和褶皱纹理，且没有穿内衣。外面随意套着一件深蓝色牛仔夹克，松松垮垮地耷拉在肩膀上。画面底部边缘可以依稀看到一件低腰牛仔裤的一部分。

画面质感：
整张照片呈现出自然的“低保真”质感，焦点偏软，虽然脸部清晰，但并非锐利如刀。画面中带有明显的低光噪点，看起来就像一张普通的、真实发布在网上的iPhone自拍。

prompts.title: 粉红女郎
prompts.content:
【Task Objective】
Generate a highly faithful dreamy creamy pink-toned portrait photoshoot image, with a strong emphasis on locking in the subject’s facial features and appearance, hair color, eye color, facial proportions, and waist-to-hip body curve, presenting a refined, softly mature atmosphere in a close-range over-the-shoulder seated pose.
【Aspect Ratio】
9:16 vertical composition.

【Main Subject / Primary Object】
A top-tier Korean internet celebrity aged 22–28, with a slight anime-style retouched aesthetic, a small face, an attractive head-to-body proportion, thin shoulders, a narrow back, slender arms, a very slim waist, rounded and full hips, and softly fleshy thighs without being overly thick. Overall, the body should show a contrasting silhouette of a slim upper body and clearly defined waist-to-hip curves.
【Facial Features and Skin】
A slightly small oval face shape, a smooth jawline, a full forehead, light blue-green eyes, relatively large eye openings, a clear and translucent gaze, a slim and straight nose bridge, a small delicate nose tip, small yet full lips, a soft Cupid’s bow, a faint smile, extremely fair skin, creamy soft-focus skin texture, pores softened but still retaining real human flesh texture, no plastic look, and no overly strong Western-style bone structure.

【Hairstyle】
Light pink shoulder-length straight hair, in a cooler-toned pink shade, with smooth strands, naturally inward-curved and slightly scattered ends, a side part, no heavy curls, no exaggerated layers, and only slight volume at the crown.
【Clothing】
A champagne pink leaning toward nude pink, sequined body-hugging long dress, with a deep open-back design, tightly following the curves of the waist, hips, and legs. The material is a densely packed fine-glitter sequin fabric, not satin, not a tulle dress, and not a wedding gown.

【Pose and Expression】
Both knees together, kneeling sideways on a soft cushioned surface, with the body and thighs oriented overall toward the left side of the frame, not kneeling toward the front. The hips rest on the heels, both lower legs folded beneath the body, the tops of both feet pressed against the cushion, and the feet positioned slightly toward the rear right side of the frame, forming a stable sideways kneeling posture. The upper body remains upright, the torso turned sideways, the bare back facing largely toward the camera, with the shoulder and back lines fully extended. The head turns back over the shoulder toward the camera, with a gentle, sweet expression carrying a restrained hint of flirtatious charm.
【Scene Environment】
An indoor space in white and creamy pink tones, with soft blankets, a white woven chair, blurred floral arrangements, and mirrored decorations. The environment should serve only as support and must not overpower the subject. The overall feel should be light and airy.

【Composition Requirements】
The subject occupies the visual focus of the frame, with the hips and legs forming the lower-half visual center of gravity, while the face is placed in the upper-right area, creating an over-the-shoulder eye contact composition. Preserve the continuous curve from the back to the hips and legs. Keep the background largely blurred with negative space to emphasize the subject.
【Camera Angle and Lens Language】
Close-range shooting, with the camera position slightly above the hips and close to waist-back height, from a two-thirds rear-side perspective. A 28–35mm smartphone or mild wide-angle look, with slight perspective enlargement to make the lower-body curves more present, but without distorting the face.

【Lighting Requirements】
High-key soft lighting, with mixed diffused light from the upper side and rear side. Overall exposure is bright, shadows are extremely soft, and highlights have a slight bloom and haze effect. The face, shoulders, and back should have creamy soft luminous highlights. No hard shadows, no direct flash feeling.
【Color Style】
The overall image should consist of white, cream, nude pink, and light champagne pink, forming a low-contrast, high-brightness visual. The color temperature is slightly warm and neutral-leaning, dreamy and softly sweet.

【Materials and Texture】
The skin should appear as smooth creamy skin, the hair straight and silky, the dress made of high-density fine glitter sequins, and the background should have a light glassy haze and milky-white blur.
【Props】
A white woven chair, a white fluffy carpet, blurred floral arrangements, and mirrored reflective decorations, which may be subdued but should retain a light luxury boudoir atmosphere.

【Final Image Aura】
Dreamy, sweet, strongly retouched in feel, softly mature and sensual, creamy soft lighting, with the visual focus clearly placed on the facial features and body proportions.
【Hard Locks】
Small face, light blue-green eyes, light pink shoulder-length straight hair.
Thin shoulders, narrow back, slim waist, rounded and full hips, soft thighs.
A seated pose looking back at the camera, with the back facing the camera.
A champagne pink sequined open-back body-hugging long dress.
High-exposure soft-focus creamy lighting, with a blurred indoor background in white and creamy pink tones.

【Negative Constraints】
No generic influencer face, no wide face, no heavy Western-style makeup, no dark hair, no blonde hair, no brown eyes, no exaggerated false eyelashes, no flat hips, no straight tubular waistline, no muscular legs, no overly large breasts stealing focus, no ordinary satin evening gown, no wedding dress, no hard shadows, no strong flash, no sharp documentary style, no messy background, no low-saturation dark grayish tones.
